test_pipe_basic: test the DataFrame.pipe method applies a function with positional arguments to the object
test_pipe_tuple: test the DataFrame.pipe method with a function name tuple and positional arguments
test_pipe_tuple_error: test the DataFrame.pipe method raises ValueError when the function name conflicts with a keyword argument

test_pipe_frame_or_series: test the DataFrame and Series pipe method with a lambda function and numeric argument
